population_kind: synthetic planar HCW challenge population; weights are design weights, not operational prevalence

strata.justification: separates nominal integration behavior from fault responses

strata.mechanism: frozen +8 m primary-only radial measurement bias for 30 s with independent monitor channel unaffected
strata.justification: the monitor architecture can identify and alter a primary-derived command only when information is not shared

strata.mechanism: frozen 6 s primary-only packet dropout with independent monitor channel unaffected
strata.justification: tests loss of primary information separately from biased information
detects harm introduced by the monitor path without conflating it with primary-estimator faults
separates monitor logic failure from monitor estimator failure

strata.mechanism: frozen bias shared by primary and monitor navigation channels
strata.justification: an independent monitor cannot be credited for protection when both information channels share the same corruption

strata.mechanism: frozen 50% command effectiveness with actuator uncertainty
strata.justification: actuation loss occurs after both command paths and must not be mislabeled as estimator or monitor failure
physical disturbance enters truth propagation independently of navigation and monitor logic

technical_failure_policy.estimator_and_monitor_fault_flags: reported mechanism-specifically and never relabeled as physical collision, keep-out entry, or corridor departure
technical_failure_policy.invalid_action_or_numerical_failure: separate technical invalidity; any occurrence closes confirmatory inference
technical_failure_policy.infrastructure_failure_or_missing_cell: no retry, replacement, imputation, or extension; any occurrence closes confirmatory inference
